- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Language is seen as a powerful tool for shaping reality in this magical system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Magic users can use language to change the world, cast spells, craft illusions, or communicate with magical creatures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mastery of language is crucial for success as a magic user.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The magical system emphasizes the importance of education and the power of language, encouraging individuals to develop their language abilities.
